verdict.rationale: The pack has no evidence of AI-generated insights or suggestions surfaced inside the LaunchDarkly product. The MCP server lets an external AI client (Cursor, Claude Code) query flags and observability data in natural language, which is an adjacent, client-side route rather than in-product AI. Bayesian 'leading variation' highlighting and stale-flag analytics are statistical or rules-based features, not AI-generated suggestions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
